feedback: deterministic, grounding, and model story critics accept

findings.detail: name questions must request the full name explicitly
opening paragraph must read as narration, not an ID table
Deterministic grounding reports no missing required fact realizations, no duplicate scene assignments, and no unknown scene obligations.
The evidence is presented in coherent scene-based prose rather than tables, bullet ledgers, or an unusable personnel index. Status assignments are consistent across each person and stream.

The main, intermediate, counterfactual, and scalar questions are unambiguous. The narrative states the status scale, tally procedure, accepted tally, and qualification rule without directly naming the qualifying person in the story.
